content: D&D1 (Lancaster/Bristol, CC-BY-NC, github benshreeve/decisions-disruptions-kit): 4 rounds, 100k per round, underspend carries over, no borrowing/debt. Deterministic hard-coded attack table (attack X happens if control Y not bought by round N). GM does not read attack type in round summary; full attacker reveal only after round 4. Losses/penalties are tracked separately and do NOT reduce next year's budget; final score = total losses. GM tracks state on a photocopied attack table (circle countered stage, scratch line). Debrief compares to a 'perfect game' purchase sequence. Tips: quick vote to break debate deadlock; shrinking round timers (12/9/7.5/7.5 min). Purchasable Threat Assessment / Asset Audit give intel mid-round.
